# Blitz Split

> Blitz Split (Bora Rachar in Brazil) is an app to split bills with friends: make a group, add what each one paid and see who owes whom. It works offline and needs no account. This site is its landing page and legal pages; the app itself is available on Android and the web, with iPhone, iPad and Mac coming soon.

The site is in English, Portuguese (Brazil), Portuguese (Portugal), Spanish, French, German, Italian, Polish, Dutch, Turkish, Indonesian, Japanese, Russian, Ukrainian, Korean, Arabic, Hindi, Simplified Chinese, Hebrew, Thai, Vietnamese, Traditional Chinese, Swedish, Czech, Romanian, Bengali, Malay, Greek, Hungarian, Filipino, Urdu, Croatian, Serbian, Slovak, Norwegian (Bokmål), Persian, Swahili, Tamil, Telugu, Marathi, Bulgarian, Catalan, Danish, Finnish, Latvian and Slovenian: add `?lang=en|pt|pt-PT|es|fr|de|it|pl|nl|tr|id|ja|ru|uk|ko|ar|hi|zh|he|th|vi|zh-Hant|sv|cs|ro|bn|ms|el|hu|fil|ur|hr|sr|sk|nb|fa|sw|ta|te|mr|bg|ca|da|fi|lv|sl` to a page's address to read it in one of them.

## Pages

- [Blitz Split](https://blitzsplit.com/): what the app does, how it works and where it runs
- [Privacy policy](https://blitzsplit.com/privacy): what the app collects, why, who sees it and how to delete it
- [Terms of use](https://blitzsplit.com/terms): the rules for using the app and what each side is responsible for
- [What's new](https://blitzsplit.com/release-notes): what each version of the app changed, newest first
- [Support](https://blitzsplit.com/support): how to get help with the app, report a problem or send a suggestion, by email to appborarachar@gmail.com
